sources_note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation 5 list as Exophase and PSNProfiles listed it (see the kit). Guides are written in this entry's own words from the cited guides; counts and locations are the cited guides' figures.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last trophy you will see. It pops by itself the moment the other 54 are done, so there is nothing to do for it directly — work the roadmap below and it follows. On Xbox the same slot is a Mythic achievement worth 0G.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official list as published

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed — just play through the intro.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official list as published

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story trophy, unmissable. Before the chapter ends, do the one thing in this chapter that can be missed: Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy).

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official list as published

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story trophy, unmissable. Chapter 2 is when switching between Jason and Lucia opens up, which is also when the partner trophies and several activities unlock.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official list as published

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story trophy, unmissable. The tools for the robbery trophies start arriving in this chapter — the Snap Gun for jewelry stores comes from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official list as published

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story trophy, unmissable. Near the end of this chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens the bank vaults for Maximum Withdrawal.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official list as published

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Story trophy, unmissable, and the second Gold in the list. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save from just before the final mission — you cannot go back and redo it later.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official list as published

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion, but everything you do earlier still counts, and nothing on it is missable. The long poles are 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations — keep chipping at them while you play instead of leaving them all for the end.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps all count, so vary what you do rather than repeating one jump. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 — the extra 50 count toward A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity once — 9 types in all. Work through the activities menu one by one in free roam; you only need one attempt at each, not a win.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 of them across the two ranges. Take them slowly and learn each range's pattern; golds are about accuracy and pace, not speed alone.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 in all. You only need one win per location, so move on as soon as each pops and come back for the rest later.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different races is the key word: repeats of one race do not count, so keep entering new events around Leonida.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take him on; fishing challenges reward patience and timing more than gear.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — play one through to the end. Any arcade cabinet counts; pick the shortest game you enjoy and finish it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Side-story finale, open after the credits. Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has this trophy of its own.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Side-story finale — it stays open after the credits, so there is no rush, but finish Kenton's strand before the 100% checklist matters to you.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Side-story finale, open after the credits. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has this trophy of its own.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some questlines count: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish so you know which ones counted.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Side-story finale, open after the credits.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Side-story finale, open after the credits. Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has this trophy of its own. Note the Chapter 3 race in Tyrone's strand is time-sensitive — save first, then race.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations. THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears once that chapter ends, so follow her out to the balcony of Jason's house and accept the optional task while you still can, and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. Meditation spots show as purple icons up close, and meditating at an outdoor spot with your partner along should count for both characters, so bring your partner every time.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what the hunt wants.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets, out of 18 in the game. Cards are scattered across Leonida; finish any three full sets and the trophy pops — you do not need all 18.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app as you travel and use it at each new spot; it adds up fastest if you make a habit of it on every trip instead of saving it for a grind at the end.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress, Challenges, and many finish on their own while you play. The 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80, so keep pushing past 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. The cleanest way is a bank vault job: vaults hand you 4 stars straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns this. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, once you can switch characters. Call your partner, then hit the green robbery icons one after another and never let the stars fade — if they drop to heat alone, the chain breaks. Take a few items in each shop; blowing the back-room safe with sticky bombs helps it count. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive instead of only collecting cars. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — the slow-motion aim you trigger with L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle; adrenaline extends Focus, so start it with a full meter.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge. Planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count; the planes at gates E3 and E4 work. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — a Rhino. Tanks sit parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far south-west of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops; the police come fast.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry robberies: use it on a store's locked back door, since kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good target — if someone spots you, reload rather than push on.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, out of 8 in the game. Vaults open through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner, and have a fast bike ready — every vault job brings 4 stars. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Tail a truck, hit it, grab the cash and get away — like the other robbery trophies it only pops once you are out of the heat zone.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The map starts under fog and the trophy counts once none is left. A plane clears the fog fastest, and you can get one early in Chapter 1 — fly a grid over the map and watch the fog lift.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in all. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way if you keep clearing them as you find them.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A small moment trophy: head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view — it pops from the moment itself, not from a mission.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car out through the showroom window. Pick a showroom, build a little speed inside, and go through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring sticky bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a sticky bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: Jason and Lucia both reaching maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just play. One warning from the guides: the Criminal Profile can turn Irredeemable, and that is permanent, so read up on the profile before a long rampage.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — the game's own description is a riddle and no guide has spelled out the method yet. Treat this one as unconfirmed: try the thing that failed you once, a second time, and check back as the community pins it down. This guide will not invent a method for a riddle.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Find the UFO random encounter in Kelly County after 2am: a car with flickering lights waits at the roadside and the UFO shows up further up the road. Talk to the stranger, then go back to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by: knock people over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass past a group on foot and swing as you roll by.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts and the total is cumulative, so it builds up across the whole game.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so normal spending while you play counts — check your progress before grinding purchases.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 of them, bought through the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
